title: 第16章 黑市销赃
novel_title: 苟道剑尊：从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
三日后，临泉郡腹地。

    迷雾大泽终年大雾不散，毒虫遍地。

    林渊穿着一身普通的灰色道袍，头上戴着一顶遮掩面容的斗笠，出现在大泽边缘。

    他感知了一下怀中黑市通行令的温热方向，收敛全身气息，快步走入浓雾之中。

    前行了约莫三十里，穿过数层天然的迷雾障壁后，前方的地势开始向下延伸，最终出现了一个巨大的地下溶洞入口。

    两名身穿黑色长袍、脸上戴着恶鬼面具的修士守在洞口，身上隐隐散发着炼气九层的法力波动。

    林渊走上前，没有说话，只是从袖中探出手指，亮出了那块通体漆黑的铁牌。

    其中一名面具修士仔细核对了铁牌上的法阵禁制，微微点头，声音沙哑道：“入场费，十块下品灵石。”

    林渊从怀中摸出十块灵石递了过去。

    对方收下灵石，递给林渊一张青铜材质的无面面具，侧身让开了通道。

    林渊接过面具戴在脸上。

    这面具材质特殊，能够隔绝神识的粗略探查。

    走过长长的地下甬道，眼前的视野骤然开阔。

    这是一个足有方圆数里大小的地下集市，头顶镶嵌着无数散发着微光的荧光石，将集市照得如同白昼。

    街道两旁开满了各式各样的店铺，摆摊的摊主和来往的行人都戴着面具，彼此之间极少交流，气氛显得沉闷。

    就在林渊踏入集市的瞬间，他识海中的神魂微微一颤。

    一股庞大到令人窒息的神识力量，如同微风一般从集市上空缓缓扫过。

    元婴期修士的神识！

    根据老祖留下的玉简记载，这处黑市背后的掌控者是一位元婴期的魔道散修，定下铁律维持秩序，任何人都不得在黑市中动武。

    那股恐怖的神识在林渊身上停留了半个呼吸。

    林渊面色不变，体内的液化灵力沉在气海深处，依靠着《玄金诀》的隐匿法门，将自身修为压制在炼气八层左右。

    那股元婴神识似乎并未察觉到异样，随后便移向了别处。

    林渊后背隐隐渗出一层冷汗，他加快脚步，走入了一条售卖炼器材料的偏僻巷子。

    他没有盲目去大型店铺，而是在巷子里转了几圈，最终停在了一家名为“百炼拆解铺”的小店前。

    这家店铺专门帮人拆解来历不明的法器，将其还原成原材料，虽然损耗极大，但胜在安全。

    店里只有一个年迈的独眼掌柜，坐在柜台后面抽着旱烟。

    林渊走进店内，反手将木门关上。

    他一拍储物袋，一柄乌青色的长剑落在了柜台上。

    玄金剑。

    二阶中品顶尖飞剑，林家老祖的标志性本命法器。

    独眼掌柜吐出一口青烟，斜睨了玄金剑一眼，独眼中闪过一丝异色：“青阳郡林家老祖的本命飞剑？这东西烫手得很，刘、陈两家现在正满天下找它。”

    “开个价，拆了它。”

    林渊声音沙哑，用灵力改变了声线。

    独眼掌柜伸出五根手指：“拆解费，五十块下品灵石。这剑材料底子好，拆完之后，能留下三两玄金铁精、一根完好的剑脊骨，剩下的残破剑胎也能卖点灵石。不过丑话说在前头，拆完之后，东西不能在我这卖，规矩你懂。”

    “可。”

    林渊没有废话，直接掏出五十块下品灵石拍在桌上。
content_en:
Three days later, in the hinterland of Linquan County.

    The foggy swamp remains thick all year round, and poisonous insects are everywhere.

    Lin Yuan appeared on the edge of Daze wearing an ordinary gray Taoist robe and a hat covering his face.

    He sensed the warm direction of the black market pass in his arms, gathered his breath, and walked quickly into the thick fog.

    After traveling for about thirty miles and passing through several layers of natural fog barriers, the terrain in front began to extend downwards, and finally the entrance to a huge underground cave appeared.

    Two monks wearing black robes and devil masks on their faces were guarding the entrance of the cave. Their bodies were faintly emitting mana fluctuations from the ninth level of Qi Refining.

    Lin Yuan stepped forward without saying a word, but took out his finger from his sleeve and showed the black iron plate.

    One of the masked monks carefully checked the magic circle restrictions on the iron plate, nodded slightly, and said in a hoarse voice: "The entrance fee is ten pieces of low-grade spiritual stones."

    Lin Yuan took out ten spiritual stones from his arms and handed them over.

    The other party accepted the spirit stone, handed Lin Yuan a faceless mask made of bronze, and stepped aside to get out of the way.

    Lin Yuan took the mask and put it on his face.

    This mask is made of a special material that can block the rough detection of spiritual consciousness.

    Walking through the long underground corridor, the view suddenly widens.

    This is an underground market with a radius of several miles. The top of the head is inlaid with countless fluorescent stones that emit light, illuminating the market like daylight.

    The streets are lined with a variety of shops. The stall owners and passers-by all wear masks. There is little communication with each other, and the atmosphere seems dull.

    The moment Lin Yuan stepped into the market, his soul in the sea of ​​consciousness trembled slightly.

    A huge and suffocating power of consciousness slowly swept over the market like a breeze.

    The spiritual consciousness of a monk in the Nascent Soul stage!

    According to the records on the jade slips left by the ancestors, the controller behind this black market is a Nascent Soul stage demon cultivator. He has set iron rules to maintain order and no one is allowed to use force in the black market.

    That terrifying consciousness stayed on Lin Yuan for half a breath.

    Lin Yuan's expression remained unchanged, and the liquefied spiritual power in his body sank deep into the sea of ​​qi. He relied on the hidden method of "Xuanjin Jue" to suppress his cultivation to around the eighth level of qi refining.

    The Nascent Soul consciousness didn't seem to notice anything strange, and then moved elsewhere.

    A layer of cold sweat broke out on Lin Yuan's back. He quickened his pace and walked into a remote alley selling weapon refining materials.

    Instead of blindly going to a large store, he walked around the alley a few times and finally stopped in front of a small shop called "Bai Lian Dismantling Shop".

    This shop specializes in helping people dismantle magical artifacts of unknown origin and restore them to raw materials. Although the losses are huge, it is better than safety.

    There was only an old one-eyed shopkeeper in the store, sitting behind the counter smoking a cigarette.

    Lin Yuan walked into the store and closed the wooden door with his backhand.

    He patted the storage bag, and a long black sword fell on the counter.

    Black gold sword.

    The second-level mid-grade top flying sword, the iconic natal magic weapon of the ancestor of the Lin family.

    The one-eyed shopkeeper blew out a puff of green smoke and glanced sideways at Xuanjinjian. A strange color flashed in his one-eyed eye: "The flying sword of the ancestor of the Lin family in Qingyang County? This thing is very hot. The Liu and Chen families are looking for it all over the world."

    "Make a price and tear it down."

    Lin Yuan's voice was hoarse and he used spiritual power to change his voice.

    The one-eyed shopkeeper held out five fingers: "The dismantling fee is fifty yuan of low-grade spirit stones. The material of this sword is good. After it is dismantled, you can leave three taels of black gold and iron essence, a intact sword spine, and the remaining broken sword body can also be sold for some spirit stones. But the ugly words are ahead. After the dismantling is completed, the items cannot be sold here. You know the rules."

    "Yes."

    Lin Yuan didn't waste any time and took out fifty yuan of low-grade spiritual stones and slapped them on the table.
title_en: Chapter 16 Selling stolen goods on the black market
